request.description: Adds an attribute. `key` is permanent and namespaced (`business.*`, `person.*`, `borrower.*`). `dataType`: `integer`, `decimal`, `money` (paise), `boolean`, `enum` (needs `enumValues`), `string`, `date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `percentage`. `sensitivity: special` encrypts stored values. `allowedProvenance` limits which sources may record it. `freshnessDays` marks older facts stale so rules treat them as unknown. Staff only. Reading needs attribute read access (ops lead, compliance, support); changes need attribute manage access (ops lead, super admin). Every change is audited, published as `attribute.changed` and clears the dictionary cache immediately.
